heads.text: A FORGOTTEN BEAST FROM THE CAVERNS
A MONSTER FROM THE FAR MOUNTAINS

reps.text: A forgotten beast crawled up out of the dark. Citizens are asked to seal the cavern doors and call the squads, and to keep well clear of whatever it breathes or spits.
The forgotten beast came from the caverns. The militia is moving; everyone else is moving the other way.
Elders say a forgotten beast is to be respected and avoided. The Herald agrees: seal the cavern doors and call the squads.
The fort's plan for the forgotten beast is simple: seal the cavern doors and call the squads. The fort's fear is also simple: whatever it breathes or spits.
A forgotten beast has come to {fort}. If you see it, you are too close.
A titan strode in over the hills. Citizens are asked to close the gate and man the walls, and to keep well clear of its size, mostly.
The titan came from the wilds. The militia is moving; everyone else is moving the other way.
Elders say a titan is to be respected and avoided. The Herald agrees: close the gate and man the walls.
The fort's plan for the titan is simple: close the gate and man the walls. The fort's fear is also simple: its size, mostly.
A titan has come to {fort}. If you see it, you are too close.
A werebeast came howling out of the dark. Citizens are asked to keep everyone inside until the moon passes, and to keep well clear of its bite, which spreads the curse.
The werebeast came from the night. The militia is moving; everyone else is moving the other way.
Elders say a werebeast is to be respected and avoided. The Herald agrees: keep everyone inside until the moon passes.
The fort's plan for the werebeast is simple: keep everyone inside until the moon passes. The fort's fear is also simple: its bite, which spreads the curse.
A werebeast has come to {fort}. If you see it, you are too close.
A great monster arrived like a storm. Citizens are asked to send the best squad and pray, and to keep well clear of everything about it.
The great monster came from the far mountains. The militia is moving; everyone else is moving the other way.
Elders say a great monster is to be respected and avoided. The Herald agrees: send the best squad and pray.
The fort's plan for the great monster is simple: send the best squad and pray. The fort's fear is also simple: everything about it.
A great monster has come to {fort}. If you see it, you are too close.
A beast showed up uninvited. Citizens are asked to keep clear and let the militia handle it, and to keep well clear of its teeth.
The beast came from the wilds. The militia is moving; everyone else is moving the other way.
Elders say a beast is to be respected and avoided. The Herald agrees: keep clear and let the militia handle it.
The fort's plan for the beast is simple: keep clear and let the militia handle it. The fort's fear is also simple: its teeth.
A beast has come to {fort}. If you see it, you are too close.

kickers.text: Stay inside. Seal the cavern doors and call the squads.
Do not feed the forgotten beast.
Stay inside. Close the gate and man the walls.
Stay inside. Keep everyone inside until the moon passes.
Stay inside. Send the best squad and pray.
Do not feed the great monster.
Stay inside. Keep clear and let the militia handle it.
